title: The Great Gatsby
description: A story of wealth, love, and the American Dream set in the Jazz Age. Nick Carraway narrates the mysterious life of Jay Gatsby, a self-made millionaire obsessed with his lost love Daisy Buchanan.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
description: A gripping tale of racial injustice and childhood innocence in the American South. Lawyer Atticus Finch defends a Black man falsely accused of a crime in 1930s Alabama, seen through the eyes of his young daughter Scout.

A chilling dystopian novel about a totalitarian society under the watchful eye of Big Brother. Winston Smith works for the Party rewriting history, but secretly dreams of rebellion against the oppressive regime.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: A witty romantic novel about manners, marriage, and social class in early 19th-century England. Elizabeth Bennet navigates the social expectations of her time while falling for the proud Mr. Darcy.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
description: A coming-of-age story following rebellious teenager Holden Caulfield as he wanders New York City after being expelled from prep school, wrestling with identity, alienation, and the phoniness of the adult world.

title: Brave New World
description: A dystopian novel set in a futuristic World State where citizens are engineered and conditioned into a rigid caste system. Bernard Marx begins to question the pleasure-driven, consumer society he inhabits.

title: The Lord of the Rings
description: An epic high-fantasy trilogy following hobbit Frodo Baggins and his companions on a quest to destroy the One Ring and defeat the Dark Lord Sauron. A foundational work of modern fantasy literature.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: The first book in the beloved Harry Potter series. An orphaned boy discovers he is a wizard and enters the magical world of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he makes friends and faces his destiny.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
description: A comedic science-fiction novel following Arthur Dent, an ordinary Englishman who is whisked away from Earth moments before its demolition to make way for a hyperspace bypass. The universe turns out to be deeply weird and very funny.

title: Fahrenheit 451
description: A dystopian novel about a future American society where books are outlawed and firemen burn any that are found. Fireman Guy Montag begins to question the book-burning culture he has always accepted.

title: Animal Farm
description: A political allegory in which farm animals overthrow their human farmer, only to find their revolution betrayed by the pigs who take power. A biting satire of Stalinist Russia and totalitarianism in general.

title: The Alchemist
description: A philosophical novel about Santiago, an Andalusian shepherd boy who travels from Spain to the Egyptian desert in search of treasure. His journey becomes a spiritual quest about following one's dreams and Personal Legend.

title: Jane Eyre
description: A Gothic novel following orphan Jane Eyre from her unhappy childhood to her employment as a governess at Thornfield Hall, where she falls in love with the brooding Mr. Rochester and uncovers his dark secret.

title: Moby-Dick
description: An epic sea adventure narrated by Ishmael, a sailor aboard the whaling ship Pequod captained by the obsessed Ahab, who pursues the legendary white whale Moby Dick across the world's oceans to his doom.

title: Crime and Punishment
description: A psychological thriller following Raskolnikov, an impoverished student in St. Petersburg who murders a pawnbroker believing himself above moral law. The novel explores guilt, redemption, and the psychology of crime.

title: The Hobbit
description: A fantasy novel following the hobbit Bilbo Baggins who is swept into an epic quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain from the dragon Smaug, accompanied by the wizard Gandalf and thirteen dwarves.

title: Dune
description: A science-fiction epic set in the distant future amid a feudal interstellar society. Paul Atreides is thrust into a conflict on the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the most valuable substance in the universe.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
description: A dystopian novel set in the near-future theocratic Republic of Gilead, where women have lost all their rights and a select few fertile women called Handmaids are forced into sexual servitude to produce children for the ruling class.

title: Wuthering Heights
description: A Gothic romance set on the Yorkshire moors, tracing the destructive love between Catherine Earnshaw and the mysterious foundling Heathcliff over two generations. A dark tale of passion, revenge, and social class.

title: War and Peace
description: An epic novel set during the Napoleonic era that interweaves the lives of five Russian aristocratic families with the broader historical canvas of the French invasion of Russia. One of the longest and most celebrated novels in world literature.
